messages:
sara_cs: Heads up — Orbitryx onboarding showing p95 jumps during peak (≥450ms). Account health = medium, renewal in ~3 months. Thinking preemptive path: compact quantized model canary + routing hedge to Dedicated. Any blocker to proposing this to the customer?

tom_eng: Can you share a quick metric snapshot? p95/p50, tokens/sec, and which model variant they're hitting now?

sara_cs: past 24h: p95=452ms, p50=118ms, tokens/sec down ~30% vs their trial baseline. No error rate increase. They are on hosted redwood/gpt-alpha-v1 (default).

tom_eng: Ok — low error but latency drift suggests token decode cost pressure. Quick non-invasive play: 1) canary a quantized int8 variant of the same family 2) add routing rule preferring dedicated (us-west-2) if available 3) enable KV prefix caching for repeated prompts. Start at 5% traffic for 24h.

elaine_enablement: I can run a 20–30min enablement with Orbitryx PM to explain perf/quality tradeoffs and how to opt into the canary. I'll schedule for Tue morning PST.

mike_sre: FYI infra side we can reserve a small Dedicated pool for the canary traffic to avoid noisy-neighbor variance. Also recommend raising request_timeout to 10s for client retries during rollout.

tom_eng: sample canary config to propose to Orbitryx (for their engineers):

```json
{
  "canary_percentage": 5,
  "model_swap": "redwood/gpt-alpha-int8-v1",
  "routing_policy": "prefer_dedicated:us-west-2",
  "kv_prefix_caching": true,
  "batch_target_ms": 20
}
```

sara_cs: love it. I'll present this in the enablement and capture qualitative feedback (diffs in hallucination/formatting). If quality is acceptable we can scale to 25% then 100% and log as a renewal upsell signal.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary routing rule -> us-west-2 Dedicated pool (5%) at 2026-03-24T15:00:00Z :rocket:

mike_sre: thumbs up. I'll monitor p95, token throughput, and model equivocation. If latency improves with no quality regressions, ops will propose a committed Dedicated plan as a renewal add-on.

elaine_enablement: I'll include a short checklist for Orbitryx: how to opt-out, who to contact, expected KPIs to watch.

sara_cs: Action items: (1) enablement session scheduled Tue AM PST (elaine) (2) 5% canary deploy Tue 15:00Z (deploy-bot/mike_sre) (3) feedback capture doc + perf diff template (sara_cs) — I'll update CSM notes and tag renewal lead. :thumbsup:

tom_eng: ping me if we need a quick fallback to hosted variant; can roll back within 5 mins.

sara_cs: thanks all — I'll post orbitryx feedback in this thread after the session and first 24h canary.
